title: Why Companies Are Cancelling SaaS Contracts and Building Their Own Tools With AI
summary: In 2026, a startup can replace $10,000+ in annual SaaS contracts with custom-built tools in a weekend. Here's the audit process, the math, and exactly what to build first.
body_markdown: Blink is built on compliant infrastructure (GDPR-ready, EU data residency option). For HIPAA compliance, you need a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) — contact Blink's enterprise team. For most internal tools and client portals, standard GDPR compliance (data deletion on request, EU hosting option) is sufficient.
